patch.value: web status/stop/doctor shadow the host-owned --json global and fail to register on pm-cli 2026.7.27

pm-cli 2026.7.27 (GH-719) makes the host reject any extension command whose flags shadow a host-owned global flag. The pm-web commands web status, web stop, and web doctor each declared { long: "--json" } in their flags array, so all three failed to register against a real pm host:

  registerCommand definition metadata invalid: registerFlags cannot shadow host-owned global flag "--json"

The existing smoke.test.ts could not catch this because it built a hand-rolled api double (extension.activate(api as any)) that accepted every registration unconditionally — green CI, broken extension.

Fix: removed the --json flag declaration from all three commands and read the value from ctx.global.json === true instead (the host owns --json globally). Rewrote smoke.test.ts on createExtensionTestHarness so it runs pm's real validation engine, and added a suite-wide guard asserting no registered command redeclares any of the nine host-owned globals. Bumped @unbrained/pm-cli to 2026.7.27 and package/manifest version to 2026.7.27.

value.text: Verified with createExtensionTestHarness probe: activation.failed=[] (no failures). All four commands (web, web status, web stop, web doctor) register against the real pm host. Suite-wide guard test confirms no command redeclares any of the nine host-owned globals. Full suite: 147/147 pass. release:check: green (typecheck, build, test, audit:prod 0 vulnerabilities, pack:dry-run, changelog:check).

patch.value: Work completed and released in 2026.7.27. Release attribution set explicitly so pm-changelog --respect-item-release files the entry under 2026.7.27 instead of the current release notes.
A closed item whose changelog entry appears under the 2026.7.27 heading it actually shipped in, leaving the current release notes untouched.
Item remained in_progress with no activity after its work shipped, so the delivery was absent from the changelog while still counting as open work in every fleet audit.

Retired as shipped: the fix stopping web status, stop and doctor from shadowing the host-owned --json global, whose commit 2bebb37 precedes the v2026.07.27 release commit eebb67e and is therefore genuinely in that release was completed and released in 2026.7.27, but the item was never closed and sat in progress ever since, inflating every fleet audit.
